subject: Buyers abroad for O'rizon Living
body:
Hello [Name], we are launching Imóveis Portugal, a free weekly newsletter and guide for people living abroad who want to buy a home in Portugal, with editions for the USA and Israel among six. We start on December 1. I saw that Shalu is building O'rizon Living on the Douro, with about 200 apartments. We offer one developer campaign per project, from 1,500 €, always labelled as sponsored, and our first ten sponsors get 40% off the first year. Could we have 15 minutes next week for me to show you the format?

If you'd rather not hear from us again, just reply and say so.

[Assinatura]

organisation: AmCham Portugal (Câmara de Comércio Americana em Portugal)
subject: A guide for Americans buying in Portugal
body:
Hello [Name], we are launching Imóveis Portugal, a free weekly newsletter and guide for people living abroad who want to buy a home in Portugal, with a USA edition in English. We start on December 1. Your members include companies that serve US citizens in Portugal, and AmCham Portugal's monthly newsletter and events reach them. We would like to invite members to write a labelled guest post for us, and to hear about your own sponsorship options; our first ten sponsors get 40% off the first year. Could we have a short call to see what would suit AmCham?

If you'd rather not hear from us again, just reply and say so.

[Assinatura]
hold_before_sending: Check the list of members is as described: the draft says members include companies that serve US citizens.

subject: A guide for Israelis buying in Portugal
body:
Hello [Name], we are launching Imóveis Portugal, a free weekly newsletter and guide for people living abroad who want to buy a home in Portugal, with an Israel edition in English. We start on December 1. We understand the chamber brings together companies active between Portugal and Israel, including in Porto. We would like to invite members to write a labelled guest post for us, and to hear about your sponsorship or partnership options; our first ten sponsors get 40% off the first year. Could we have a short call to see what would suit the chamber?

If you'd rather not hear from us again, just reply and say so.

[Assinatura]
hold_before_sending: Confirm the chamber exists and who runs it before sending (evidence is an undated article).

organisation: U.S. Commercial Service, Embassy of the United States in Lisbon
subject: Introduction request: a guide for Americans buying in Portugal
body:
Dear Sir or Madam, Imóveis Portugal is a free weekly newsletter and guide, launching on December 1, for people living abroad who want to buy a home in Portugal, with a USA edition in English. We would be grateful if the Commercial Service could share a short note about us with US companies active in Portuguese real estate. We ask for an introduction only, not an endorsement, and we will not use the Embassy's name or logo. Could you tell us who the right contact is for this?

If you'd rather not hear from us again, just reply and say so.

[Assinatura]
hold_before_sending: Introduction request only; use the office contact on trade.gov, not a named person.
